env-call.comment: env(NAME) — a taint-tracked secret reference, distinct from the `env <name>` config block keyword
env-call.name: support.function.env.tflw

keywords-statement.comment: M4a: includes the M3a-M3e browser-step keywords (open/click/.../stub) and their sub-clause words (on/to/onto/dialog/new/tab/frame/respond), catching up parser.ts's STATEMENT_KEYWORDS. M4b adds `mask` (the `mask <locator>` snapshot-masking clause). M28 adds `log` (M27 added it to STATEMENT_KEYWORDS but never caught this independent copy up — PLAN_LOG_LSP.md). M33 adds the M29-M32 load-testing leading keywords `ramp`/`over`/`threshold`/`cleanup`/`think` (all now written inside an ordinary `test` body). M50 removed the standalone `scenario` keyword (D93) — a `test` is a load test whenever it contains a `ramp to …` line. Phase 1b (D97) adds the 4 new workload keywords `hold`/`step`/`spike`/`run` and their sub-clause words `for`/`across`/`per`. Phase 2b (D105-D107) adds `parallel`/`sequential`, the optional per-test concurrency header modifier (same slot as `retry N`, legal on any test). D127 (PLAN_DISCOVERY_EXCLUDE.md) adds `exclude`, a top-level tflw.config directive.
keywords-statement.name: keyword.control.tflw

percentile.comment: M33: `p50`/`p90`/`p95`/`p99`/… (M29 `threshold p95 duration is less than 800ms`, D24a) — a dynamic ident, not fixed vocabulary (parser.ts's `parseThresholdDecl` accepts any `p` followed by 1-2 digits), so it needs its own regex rather than joining `keywords-subject`'s literal wordlist.
percentile.name: support.type.tflw

keywords-subject.comment: M4a: includes the M3a/M3e locator-noun and `page` subjects (button/field/list/css/xpath/page), catching up parser.ts's SUBJECT_KEYWORDS. M33 adds the M29 load-testing metric/target nouns `users`/`rps` (`ramp to N users|rps over …`) and `error`/`rate` (`threshold error rate is …`). Phase 1b adds `iterations`/`user` (`run N iterations per user across M users`).
keywords-subject.name: support.type.tflw

keywords-matcher.comment: M4a: includes `was`/`made` (M3d `was made`) and `no`/`a11y`/`violations`/severity words (M3e `has no [<severity>] a11y violations`). M4b adds `snapshot` (`matches snapshot "<name>"`).
keywords-matcher.name: keyword.operator.word.tflw
